g.text: 1. FOR HOLD ITEMS, TPT PIPING FIELD ENGINEER TO CONFIRM FINAL DIMENSION AT SITE.

2. PIPE ROUTING AND SUPPORTS OF LINES DN40 AND SMALLER (NO STRESS ANALYSED) ARE TO BE CONFIRMED AT SITE BY PIPING SUB-CONTRACTOR.
NEW OR MODIFICATION OF EXISTING PIPE.
